[1/2] Review the last 21 pushes: keep the %PROGRAMDATA% Windows system-config fallback

impact_assessment.why: The 21-push window added the Windows system config at %PROGRAMDATA%\\Git\\config; the later executable-relative fix replaced it. A portable or differently installed Git can have no etc/gitconfig beside the executable while the machine config remains.
impact_assessment.benefits: Both standard Windows system-config locations are checked; the executable-relative path still wins when both exist.
